notes.title: 【Announcement】TGS 2025 & Next Fest Commemorative Update!!
notes.content:
To celebrate Tokyo Game Show 2025 and the October Steam Next Fest, the demo of RETRYS is getting a major update!

We’ve added and improved many elements, including character expressions, a new chase mode, new facilities, and fresh events.

I’ve been updating non-stop this past month—totally exhausted 😁

Here are the full details of the update!!
[hr][/hr]🆕 New Features & Gameplay
Added a Chase Mode: when discovered by enemies, thrilling pursuits begin!

Expanded situations where bug programs can be used (based on feedback).

Added reactions when choosing the wrong bug program (based on feedback).

Major renovation of the Cat Mansion (a lot of effort went in!).

Added brand-new gameplay to the Castle Tower (really made me think!).

Added a secret room under the tavern (what happens if you sleep in the bed…?).

Added a jar specialty shop in town (hehe).

Added the mansion of a wealthy noble, with a mysterious new character.

Adjusted the route of the first farmer puzzle to include a light detour.
[hr][/hr]🎨 Visual Enhancements
Added eyes and mouths to character sprites (looks nice!).

Added bug creature character art (what do you think?).

Adjusted the effect colors when defeating bugs (a bit more horror).

Enhanced the cat search event in the Cat Mansion (with retro ’Showa’ references).

Changed the Game Over screen.
[hr][/hr]📖 Story & World-Building
Adjusted event dialogue to better fit story and world (still improving!).

Added an episode with a boy and his grandmother in town (slightly tear-jerking).

Added dancers to the tavern (twirl, twirl!).

Added hints in the inn (based on feedback).

Added hints in the Lost Forest (based on feedback).
[hr][/hr]🎮 UI & Presentation Improvements
Added glitch noise effects to maps with bug creatures (easier to notice).

Adjusted message window size for better readability (a subtle but nice change).

Changed map effect draw order to appear behind pictures (based on feedback).

Improved review flow: now you can open the store page directly in your browser (please leave us a review—yoroshiku!).
[hr][/hr]🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed issues occurring in the Cat Mansion.

Corrected missing images on the CRT monitor.

Removed unnecessary white edges from character images.

notes.title: A Slightly Weird RPG 🎮 'RETRYS' Free Demo Now Available!
notes.content:

If AAA games feel exhausting lately, this is a cozy adventure just for you. 🥰
